exact_goal: exists Pi:Polynomial Nat, forall n:Nat, 1 <= n -> forall A:Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Rat, exists c:Circuit n, c.gates <= Pi.eval n and c.literalBound (Pi.eval n) and c.eval A = CollisionEncodingBridge.markedPermanent A
leaves: marked i j evaluates to C(1+(A i j)^2)
rational q evaluates to Polynomial.C q
gates: add of two Fin k references when appended at node k
mul of two Fin k references when appended at node k
sharing: References name previously computed nodes, including leaves; identical references do not copy subcircuits
gate_count: Sum of binary addition and multiplication nodes; source leaves count zero, matching the article circuit convention
rational_bit_length: One numerator sign bit plus nonempty binary magnitude of normalized numerator plus nonempty binary normalized positive denominator
bit_bound_applies_to: Every rational literal; the designated p_ij leaves are explicitly exempt
forbidden_inputs: matrix entries not compiled from these leaves

uniformity.L: Total binary length of rational matrix numerators and denominators
uniformity.not_formalized_by: An abstract function equipped with an arbitrarily declared cost
